detail_text: This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes.Â Solicitation, 36C24626Q0449, will be issued on or about 24 March 2026.Â The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salisbury VAMC, Salisbury, NC has a requirement for a 3D Printer for Orthotics and Prosthetics Department.
